state_contracts.commit: Validate campaign membership, expected revision and stable idempotency key; atomically append event, update projection and save receipt.
state_contracts.time: Advance only actual fictional duration once; calendar derives from arrival plus elapsed time. No advancement from replies, browsing or pause.
state_contracts.heat: Clamp 0..6; severity 0/1/2 per delivered incident; apply only positive difference from previously applied incident severity. Knowledge requires delivered evidence.
state_contracts.lay_low: A full fictional day without a new report reduces Heat by one, minimum zero.
state_contracts.supplies: Charge one party-day of food once per field day, offset by actual meals or food magic; record any unmet need for selected rules to resolve.
state_contracts.support: Clamp 0..3; award once per distinct outcome; never treat as island-wide opinion.
state_contracts.foundry_delay: Before invasion launch, award max(0, outcome_total - foundry_delay_awarded_days), at most two days total. After launch, modify reinforcements without reversing launch.
state_contracts.deadline: Launch once when actual time reaches dawn on adjusted invasion day; continue play.
state_contracts.channel: Consume unique token atomically for one message OR one crossing.
state_contracts.milestones: One per distinct resolved operation, at most five; never award again on upgrade. Existing campaign policy takes precedence.
state_contracts.public_output: Build an allowlisted projection from disclosed knowledge. Never serialize this entire GM-only blueprint to clients.
